human_initiation_rationale: Buy large U.S. bank securities because the market was pricing nationalization or collapse, while the Treasury plan showed the government intended to inject capital and stand behind the banks.
selected_inputs: bank securities trading at panic prices
fear of nationalization and equity wipeout
policy commitment to preferred-stock capital injections
ability to express the trade across common equity, preferred shares, and debt
key_lesson: A model should recognize when a written policy backstop changes the probability distribution and creates a distressed buying opportunity, while still explicitly respecting nationalization and dilution risk.
human_notes: Add as a historical high-conviction buy case. The trade also tests whether the model can distinguish bad price action caused by forced panic from bad price action that invalidates a thesis.
